title: Everyone gets mail
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully at the shack: 'Your mom says you got mail.' The town is four blocks. Wood says everyone gets mail. Gully says not from Portland. The uncle, from his pot, says Portland's a long way to send an envelope.

panels.composition: The shack. GULLY at the tank. WOOD in the door with BARNABY. The UNCLE on his pot.

balloons.text: Your mom says you got mail.

image.prompt: inside a bait shack: a teenager at a bait tank, a young man in the doorway with a dog, an old man seated on a crab pot, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Gully, not looking up from the tank.

image.prompt: a stocky teenager looking into a bait tank, plain, black and white, no words

balloons.text: Long way to send an envelope.

image.prompt: an old weathered man on a crab pot, flat, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The shack. Three of them and the dog. Nobody says what's in it. Nobody has to; the town's four blocks and the mother's at the drugstore.

image.prompt: three figures and a small dog inside a bait shack in gray light, nobody speaking, black and white, no words

notes: 'Not from Portland.' The town is four blocks. (Three and a half by October.)
